display.purpose: Hero headline only, sits at the 96px format ceiling.

headline.purpose: Mobile menu links, major section headers.

title.purpose: Card headings — service names, stat labels. Always uppercase Barlow Condensed.

body.purpose: Paragraph copy, form helper text. 65-75ch measure.

label.purpose: Buttons, nav pills, badges. Smallest text, always tracked wide.

shadows.name: hover-glow
shadows.purpose: Public-site card hover, paired with amber border shift.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default transition easing across hover/focus state changes.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main CTA button — 'Book Now' / 'Book Your Appointment'.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-block; background: #FF9500; color: #111111; padding: 12px 28px; font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 3px; border: none; transition: background 0.2s, transform 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover, .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { background: #E08400; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #FF9500; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Link
components.description: Phone number / underlined text link, secondary action.
components.css: .ds-link-ghost { color: #FF9500; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: rgba(255,149,0,0.4); font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 0.06em; font-weight: 500; } .ds-link-ghost:hover { text-decoration-color: #FF9500; }

components.name: Service Card
components.description: Public-site service tile with tilt + amber glow on hover.
components.html:
⚙

Oil Change

Full synthetic or conventional oil changes with filter replacement and fluid top-up.
components.css: .ds-service-card { background: #2A2420; border: 1px solid #3A3430; border-radius: 3px; padding: 24px; transition: border-color 0.3s, box-shadow 0.3s; } .ds-service-card:hover { border-color: rgba(255,149,0,0.5); box-shadow: 0 0 32px rgba(255,149,0,0.12); } .ds-service-icon { width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(255,149,0,0.12); color: #FF9500; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; margin-bottom: 16px; } .ds-service-title { font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #F0EDE8; margin-bottom: 4px; } .ds-service-desc { font-size: 12px; color: #9A8E82; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Admin Stat Card
components.description: Dashboard KPI tile with count-up value, used in /workshop-portal.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-stat-card { background: #1E1C18; border: 1px solid #2A2420; border-radius: 12px; padding: 24px; min-height: 120px; transition: border-color 0.2s, transform 0.15s; } .ds-stat-card:hover { border-color: rgba(255,149,0,0.5); } .ds-stat-icon { width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(255,149,0,0.12); color: #FF9500; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; margin-bottom: 14px; } .ds-stat-value { font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; font-size: 28px; font-weight: 700; color: #F0EDE8; } .ds-stat-label { font-size: 12px; color: #9A8E82; margin-top: 4px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard form field used across the booking flow.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #1E1A16; border: 1px solid #3A3430; border-radius: 3px; padding: 12px 14px; color: #F0EDE8; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; transition: border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #9A8E82; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #FF9500; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(255,149,0,0.15); } .ds-input.error { border-color: #FF4444; }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Public navbar link with active-state underline.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { font-family: 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; color: #9A8E82; text-decoration: none; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; padding-bottom: 2px; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; transition: color 0.2s; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #F0EDE8; } .ds-nav-link--active { color: #F0EDE8; border-bottom-color: #FF9500; }

components.name: Fuel Gauge
components.description: Per-mechanic workload bar in the admin dashboard; pulses when over capacity.
components.css: .ds-fuel-gauge { width: 100%; height: 8px; background: #2A2420; border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-fuel-gauge-fill { height: 100%; background: #FF9500; border-radius: 4px; } .ds-fuel-gauge-fill--over { animation: ds-gauge-pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-gauge-pulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: 0.85; } 50% { opacity: 1; } }

narrative.overview:
FixRight's public site is a garage bay that's still lit and working after the sun's gone down — warm charcoal darkness (#1E1A16) pierced by amber shop-light (#FF9500), with the occasional cyan flicker of a diagnostic scanner. It reads as rugged and precise at once: a shop that's been doing this for 28 years and still runs its diagnostics exactly right. The admin panel is the same garage from the inside — same palette, same materials — but built as a working tool rather than a storefront: rounder corners, denser information, no glow-and-tilt flourish, because Omar and his mechanics need speed, not seduction.

The system explicitly rejects the generic "local auto shop" template look: no stock blue-on-white palettes, no default Bootstrap card grids, no icon-pack-and-stock-photo assembly. Every surface should feel like it was built for this specific shop's specific workflow (phone-in bookings, mechanic assignment, HST invoicing) — not a repurposed CRM or website builder theme.
keyCharacteristics: Dark, warm charcoal base with amber as the dominant signal color — never a light theme
Flat surfaces at rest; depth communicated through border + glow on interaction, not drop shadows
Sharp 3px corners on the public site (tool/garage precision); rounder 12px corners in the admin panel (workspace ergonomics)
Barlow Condensed for anything shouting a label or headline (uppercase, tracked); Inter for anything meant to be read at length
Cyan is a diagnostic accent only — rare, reserved for scan-line/HUD/tech-signal moments, never a general-purpose color

rules.name: The One Glow Rule
rules.body: Amber glow is the system's only elevation signal on hover. Don't invent a second hover-glow color.

rules.name: The Cyan Is Rare Rule
rules.body: Diagnostic cyan appears in fewer than 10% of any given screen. If cyan starts showing up on buttons or general UI chrome, it's been misused.

rules.name: The All-Caps-Means-Barlow Rule
rules.body: Any uppercase, letter-spaced text in the system is set in Barlow Condensed, never Inter uppercased.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows and glow exist only as a response to state — hover, focus, or active.

dos: Do keep the base palette dark and warm (#1E1A16 family) — this is a night-shift-garage system, never a light theme.
Do use the sharp 3px radius on the public site and the rounder 12px radius in /workshop-portal as two deliberate, register-specific shape languages — don't unify them.
Do reserve diagnostic cyan (#00D4FF) for HUD/scan-line/diagnostic-icon moments only.
Do set uppercase/tracked text in Barlow Condensed, never Inter.
Do communicate depth via tonal layering + interactive amber glow, never a resting-state drop shadow.
Do keep Omar's real phone number (519.471.9462) and shop address specific and visible.
donts: Don't ship a generic "local auto shop" template look.
Don't let the admin panel read as an off-the-shelf SaaS dashboard template.
Don't use border-left/border-right colored stripes as an accent anywhere.
Don't add drop shadows to cards at rest.
Don't use cyan as a general-purpose accent or CTA color.
